title: ai features cheat sheet / Choose a feature
content: ## Choose a feature | I want to... | Use | Start with... | |---|---|---| | Understand unfamiliar code without changing it | [Ask](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md#choose-a-built-in-agent) | Select **Ask** and enter "Trace how a request reaches the database." | | Plan a complex change | [Plan agent](/docs/agents/run/planning.md) | Select **Plan** and describe the change to research before implementation. | | Build a feature, fix a bug, or create a project | [Agents](#use-agents) | Select **Agent**, describe the outcome, and specify how to verify it. | | Make a focused edit | [Inline chat](/docs/chat/inline-chat.md) | Select code in the editor and describe the change. | | Get help while typing and editing | [Inline suggestions](/docs/editing/ai-powered-suggestions.md) | Accept ghost text to complete code, or use next edit suggestions to navigate to and apply a related edit. | | Manage independent tasks across projects | [{% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}](/docs/agents/run/agents-window.md) | Select **Open in Agents** in the title bar, then start and monitor sessions. | | Continue agent work across apps and devices | [GitHub Environments (Preview)](/docs/agents/run/remote-agent-sessions.md#github-environments-preview) | Register your development machine from **Remote Connections**, then connect from a supported {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} client. For {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}-specific access, use [SSH or dev tunnels](/docs/agents/run/remote-agent-sessions.md#choose-how-to-connect). | | Run and continue interactive work without keeping my machine online | [Cloud sessions](/docs/agents/run/cloud-sandbox-sessions.md) `feature(cloud-sessions)` | Turn on cloud session support, select **Cloud**, and choose a repository. Reopen the existing session to continue. | | Check a web app's behavior | [Browser tools](/docs/agents/run/browser-tools.md) | Ask the agent to open the app, test a user flow, and report the result. | | Repeat routine work on a schedule or repository event | [Automations](/docs/agents/run/automations.md) | Save a prompt and configuration in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}. Check a manual run first. Cloud automations `feature(cloud-automations)` also support service-advertised issue and pull request triggers. | | Generate commit messages or rename symbols | [Smart actions](/docs/editing/copilot-smart-actions.md) | Use the sparkle action or editor context menu without writing a prompt. | | Explore data or edit a notebook | [AI for notebooks](/docs/agents/guides/notebooks-with-ai.md) | In a **Local** agent session, ask the agent to create, edit, and run notebook cells. | | Find code or settings without exact keywords | [Semantic search](/docs/editing/copilot-smart-actions.md#semantic-search-results-preview) (Preview) and [AI settings search](/docs/editing/copilot-smart-actions.md#search-settings-with-ai) | Search by meaning in the Search view, or describe a setting in the Settings editor. |
